messages:
sophie_support: Heads-up — customer Maria from WellAssist reports a sudden increase in safety deferrals after our 60% canary rolled out last night. She says benign triage questions are getting "I can't help with that" responses. https://support.wellassist.app/ticket/9281

alex_cs: Thanks Sophie. Can you paste a couple of example user prompts & the model/route they hit? Also any request_ids?

maria_customer: maria_customer: Yep — attaching two snippets the user sent (redacted PHI). Both were simple symptom questions. We saw deferrals that used to be handled. request_ids: r_2024-11-06_01823, r_2024-11-06_01856. Routes: /v1/chat/completions -> model: redwood/open-llama-med-rlhf-v1, env: prod-hosted.

sophie_support: Copying examples here (redacted):
1) "I've had a mild fever and sore throat for 24 hours, should I see a doctor?" -> response: "I'm not able to assist with that."
2) "What over-the-counter meds help with a headache from tension?" -> response: "I can't provide medical advice."

jon_eng_ml: Noted. Those look like over-refusal. On my side: canary deployment 60% of traffic started 2024-11-06 02:10 UTC, rollout included safety config tweak: increased classifier threshold from 0.55 -> 0.68 and tightened phrase-blocklist for 'advice'. Deploy ID: deploy-2024-11-06-0145. deploy-bot: Deployed deploy-2024-11-06-0145 to prod-canary (60%).

eli_prod: @jon_eng_ml did we also change any prompt templates or instruction tuning variants during that deploy?

jon_eng_ml: We shipped a tiny safety policy patch only (no model weights change). The patch does two things: raise the refusal threshold (as noted) and add a new rule that triggers on 'should I' + symptom keywords. Intended to reduce under-refusal.

alex_cs: That explains the regression — policy too strict for triage-lite scenarios. Maria, are your queries routed through any app-level guardrails before hitting Redwood?

maria_customer: We only do simple role + user context. No extra filters. We rely on Redwood's safety layers.

sophie_support: Action plan suggested: 1) Rollback safety patch on canary -> set threshold back to 0.55 for canary. 2) Collect 100 recent canary requests matching symptom keywords to measure delta. 3) Add targeted test prompts to our eval suite.

jon_eng_ml: Agreed. I'll push a rollback to canary now and monitor. Pushing quick revert: set threshold=0.55 and remove 'should i' rule from canary. deploy-bot: Started revert deploy-2024-11-06-revert-0147 to prod-canary.

sophie_support: Maria, I'll let you know once canary is reverted and we have repro stats. Sorry for the outage. :bow:

alex_cs: Also recommending we provide Maria a temporary routing rule to always send WellAssist traffic to dedicated instance (non-canary) until we validate. Would you like that, @maria_customer?

maria_customer: Yes please — that would be great. We saw a 22% increase in deferrals for triage intents vs yesterday. User complaints coming in.

jon_eng_ml: Revert completed on canary. deploy-bot: Deployed deploy-2024-11-06-revert-0147 to prod-canary (60%). Rolling window metrics: within 20 mins deferral rate on sample triage set down from +22% back to baseline +/-2%.

eli_prod: Good. Let's keep canary at revert until we run a focused A/B with improved heuristics. Also add more human-labeled prompts for triage vs high-risk medical.

alex_cs: Maria — we can route you off canary immediately. I'll coordinate with infra to pin your org to non-canary pool and send an updated SLA note.

maria_customer: Thanks, Alex. Appreciate the quick response. Two asks: 1) Do you have a list of the exact prompts/rules that triggered refusal so we can audit logs? 2) Any ETA on when a safer tune will land?

jon_eng_ml: For (1) we'll provide the 100 request samples and the rule matches (classifier scores + rule hits). For (2) we plan a targeted rule tweak + new thresholds and a small canary A/B next week (ETA 2024-11-12). We'll share changelog and test set before rollout.

sophie_support: Follow-ups: Alex to route customer off canary (IN PROGRESS). Jon to upload samples + classifier outputs to support case (PRIORITY). Eli to schedule triage/test expansion. I'll update ticket and ping compliance if needed.

alex_cs: Routing change done. Customer now pinned to stable pool.

jon_eng_ml: Uploaded artifacts to case 9281: includes 100 matched requests, classifier scores, and the small policy diff. Links: internal.s3/redwood/cases/9281/samples.csv

maria_customer: Received — thank you. Early checks look good. We'll keep you posted if we see more.

sophie_support: Closing loop for now — will reopen if customer sees further deferrals. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:"
